flex_eyebrow: Flexible day pass plans · Recurring monthly · 5+ team minimum
flex_headline: Don't know who, when, or how often?
flex_sub: Pay for flexibility, not commitment. Pooled day passes that recur monthly, shareable across your team, full Club access on each visit. Upgrade between Flex tiers anytime, or pair with a Team Plan above when your team needs both dedicated seats and on-demand flexibility.
coworking_headline: What's included with every pass: Coworking access
coworking_sub: Every Flex day pass unlocks the full Club for that day. Here's what that means.
fitness_headline: What's included with every pass: Performance Club access
fitness_sub: Every Flex day pass also unlocks the full Performance Club for the day. Work and a workout, all on one pass.
final_cta_headline: Bring your team in to see it.
final_cta_sub: We can accommodate tours daily, Monday to Friday. Walk the Library, Theatre, The Vault podcast studio, The Performance Club, and Teams Floor. Meet the Den 1880 team, grab an espresso, ask anything. No pressure.
